domainConclusions.statement: Standard and chapter Lambda paths share durable finalization, but project/source/timebase identity, full format QC and the separate SSR helper prevent a complete convergence claim.
Current output is a narrow H.264 web master plus an optional platform-native music handoff; interchange, conform, mastering variants, professional QC and archive remain missing.
Fixed 30-fps chapter constants and a three-hour finalizer cap disprove four-to-five-hour, multi-rate production readiness despite useful chapter orchestration.
Some recent workers fail closed, but twelve inspected internal routes still select raw handlers when signing keys are absent; security convergence is not achieved.
